note: Goshen County has no county zoning regulations (county Planning & GIS page). County ArcGIS services at gis.goshencounty.org (CountyWebViewer, CivicPlus, COT) hold no zoning layer; parcel layer has no zoning field. City of Torrington adopts and amends a zoning district map by ordinance (2023 agendas, 2026 public notices) but no queryable zoning polygon service was found on the city site, county GIS or ArcGIS Online; the map appears to be published only as documents/images.
